name: @bridge-zero/relayer
description: Fetches Portaldot finality and storage proofs, captures and re-verifies chain fixtures, relays finality to the Sepolia light clients, deploys and uses the vault on the V3 testnet, mints wtPOT on Sepolia from a proven lock, and runs the trusted return path: a burn on Sepolia and its release by the committee on V3.
